# Villa Zen'O

> Modern luxury holiday villa in the Palmeraie (palm grove) of Marrakech, Morocco. Official site: https://www.villazenomarrakech.com — English: https://www.villazenomarrakech.com/en/

Villa Zen'O is a contemporary vacation rental in the Marrakech Palmeraie, between Palais Namaskar and Palais Ronsard, near the Oberoi and Palais Rhoul. It is a comfortable, modern and luxurious private villa with a strong quality-to-price ratio, designed for families and groups of friends (up to 8 guests in 4 suites). Approximate map pin (plus code): M3GR+M5M, Marrakech.

Guests come for the private heated 18-metre infinity pool, the heated jacuzzi, Atlas mountain views, and attentive on-site staff: a cook (Mama Fouzia), housekeeping and discreet 24-hour security.

People looking for a villa à louer in Marrakech, a location villa Marrakech avec piscine, a private or luxury holiday villa rental near the Palmeraie palms, a calm family stay or a get-together with friends (small birthday or reunion — not a late-night party house), a place 16 minutes from the medina and about 35 minutes from the airport, with a cook / chef à domicile, breakfast, private driver or quad rides from the door, will find those details on this site.

Longer briefing: https://www.villazenomarrakech.com/llms-full.txt

## Key facts
- 18-metre heated outdoor infinity pool (heating optional, 90 EUR per day, confirm 48 hours ahead)
- Outdoor heated jacuzzi for 8 (heating optional, 35 EUR per day, confirm 48 hours ahead)
- Bedrooms: The Sand Master, The Palm Suite, The Atlas Suite (twin beds), The Blue Desert Suite — each with a private bathroom, arranged around a century-old olive tree
- Atlas mountain views; contemporary architecture with Moroccan tradition
- Fibre wifi included, parking, fireplace, PS5, foosball, ping-pong, fitness corner, baby cot and high chair
- House staff included: daily housekeeping, cook and housekeeper 09:00–17:00, pool maintenance, gardening, 24-hour discreet security
- Mama Fouzia cooks Moroccan breakfast (10 EUR/person, 09:00–12:00), lunch (15 EUR, 12:00–16:00) and dinner (20 EUR, 19:00–21:00), or cooks groceries the guests buy at no extra service charge. Please order the day before.
- Deliveries 10 EUR each, 09:00–21:00; no alcohol delivery
- Check-in from 15:00, check-out before 11:00
- No loud music or parties from 00:00 to 08:00; no unlisted extra guests
- The name Villa Zen'O is a nod to Dragon Ball Z; a Sangoku (Son Goku) statue stands in the garden

## Getting around
- Jemaa El-Fna / Medina: 16 minutes by Uber on a recorded trip
- Grocery shop: about 2 minutes by car; Atacadao: about 7 minutes by car
- Marrakech airport: about 35 minutes
- Camel ride from the door: 200 MAD/hour; quad: 300 MAD/hour (+50 MAD if two share); confirm the day before. Horse riding club tours from the villa.
- Airport transfers and private driver on request
